title: C++ Programming: From Problem Analysis to Program Design, Fourth Edition
research_problem: calculate a customer's checking account balance at the end of each month
main_contribution: program that reads a transaction file, updates the balance after each transaction, applies a $25 service fee if the balance falls below $1000, and prints an account summary including account number, beginning balance, ending balance, interest paid, total deposited amount, number of deposits, total withdrawn amount, number of withdrawals, and any service charge
methodology: Get the account number and beginning balance
Get transaction code and transaction amount
Analyze transaction code and update the appropriate variables (add for D/d/I/i, subtract for W/w)
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for all data
datasets: input file containing account number, beginning balance, and subsequent lines with transaction code (W/D/I) and transaction amount
